video.title: Build Pro Websites for Yourself (or Clients) Without Any Experience

summary: Chris Koerner demonstrates using the AI website builder Readdy to copy a kitchen-cabinet company's high-converting website for his new luxury backyard business, Backyard Funhouse (sport courts at $50-60k vs $1,500 tree jobs). The site was generated in 5 minutes, then tweaked with urgency banners and real photos, and its built-in chat and voice agents booked test appointments. He suggests starting an AI website agency for home service businesses, charging on value and A/B testing pricing via cold outreach. Key takeaway: AI builders make cloning proven designs and testing landing pages very fast.

tactics.name: Clone a high-converting site with Readdy
steps: Google 'beautiful home service business websites' and pick one you like
In Readdy, prompt: copy the design from <domain> but for <business>, services, service area cities, include a quote form
Ask for urgency elements (timer, coupon, promo tag) in the hero
Swap AI images for real project photos
Configure the AI chat and voice agent prompts; test that bookings land in Appointments

quote.text: Copy the design from kitchenc cabinet.net. But the new website needs to be for a business called Backyard Funhouse
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Copy the business practices of well-optimised competitors
steps: If a high-converting site offers financing, offer financing
Keep phone number persistent in the header
Copy menu structure and multiple calls to action

tactics.name: A/B test agency pricing through outreach
steps: Offer one prospect a flat fee
Keep the price the market accepts

tactics.name: Become GC on high-ticket jobs using subcontractors
steps: Build your own project with subcontractors
Sell the same service to others at retail

lessons.lesson: Most home service owners don't know AI can build sites in minutes, so the knowledge gap is the margin.
A well-optimised competitor site reveals their business practices (financing, persistent phone number) worth copying.
AI site builders increase the speed of testing; test several landing pages before committing.

quote.text: It speeds up the learning process so you can speed up your earning process
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Move up-market: compare ticket sizes ($1,500 tree jobs vs $50-60k sport courts).
Low-latency AI voice agents can book appointments directly into a calendar.
